name: ChestX-ray14 subset: Pneumonia
description:
Based on the NIH Chest X-ray Dataset of 14 Common Thorax Disease Categories, this contains a subset of 30,000 randomly selected exams with additional annotations created by multiple blinded annotators.

Click here for [RSNA Project Plan](https://forums.md.ai/t/rsna-str-2018-challenge-prep/17/1)

[Google Doc Version: RSNA Project Plan](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EucoCJQQtbMkOYbCISkXjV3R-oZX9WO2yD-R6mwSV6g/edit?usp=sharing)
